content.comment_body: Hello, How can I set or reset a basic boolean variable using contacts and outputs? I can activate outputs with a relay, but I can't figure out how to use a corresponding variable as an input. Is it possible to use the Q4 output, even though my [product_name] device only has 4 physical outputs? Thanks!
Addressing with Q starts in [product_name] at Q1, not at 0. The basic module includes 4 digital outputs: Q1 to Q4. For set/reset functionality, you should use latching relays or pulse relays. [IMAGE]
Are you referring to a ladder diagram? If so, please refer to the example attached. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you! The RS latch relay should work well for this purpose. Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: Users addressed how to set and reset boolean variables by referencing contacts and outputs in [product_name] programming. The main takeaway is a gap in understanding of using outputs as inputs and how to use latching or pulse relays for set/reset logic. Visual examples, like ladder diagrams, were suggested to assist with the solution.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple solution for handling boolean variables using contacts and outputs with [product_name] devices, similar to standard methods used in PLC programming.
